english: true grief is a private matter

terms.latin: Ille dolet vērē quī sine teste dolet.
terms.comment: Literally “he truly grieves who grieves without a witness”: the last line of an epigram of Martial on a woman who weeps for her father only when someone is watching.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Martial 1.33.4, checked against the Perseus Latin texts.
